Nuevo Laredo's municipal government is bringing its “Empleo en tu Colonia” job fair to Plaza Miguel Hidalgo on Wednesday, October 28, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m., according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The fair, held under the city's “Presidencia Cerquita de Ti” program, is aimed at connecting jobseekers directly with employers in the city center. The plaza sits at Guerrero and Dr. Mier, in the Sector Centro, the reports said.

Vacancies on offer span customs brokerage agencies, retail businesses, service companies and the transport sector, according to the municipal announcement. That mix matters in a border city where customs, commerce and trucking drive much of the local job market — and where a single fair in the center can reach workers who might not travel to an industrial-park hiring event.

Jobseekers are asked to bring a job application or résumé. The city also opened advance registration online, and vacancies can be consulted through the municipal employment exchange, the reports said.

For residents, the practical takeaway is timing: the fair runs for four hours, in the morning, in one central plaza. Arriving with a printed application or résumé in hand — and registered in advance where possible — is the difference between browsing and being considered on the spot.
